howToDraw: Each frame of Park: star centre goes at head anchor + offset (or perFrameOffset[anim][frame] for the exact scalp highlight). Draw the shine cell at (head.x + off.x - center.x, head.y + off.y - center.y), above the body and below everything else. Play the 6 frames at 12 fps, then wait (repeatEveryMs) and play again.
visibility: Only when the helmet slot is empty. Any helmet covers the scalp, so hide the shine while a helmet is worn.
